Operational Synthesis & Executive Commentary

Cross-Platform Analysis
Customer Service Velocity

Contact volume totalled 172 interactions (135 Freshdesk tickets and 37 telephony calls). First Response Time averaged 1.2 hours with a First Contact Resolution rate of 80%. Where is my order queries represented 28% of inbound contacts (38 tickets) for the period of 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08. This shows robust initial query absorption but highlights the necessity of proactive shipping notifications to curb WISMO volume.

Returns & Retention Health

Return rate registered at 39.6% across 116 RMA requests. Sizing disparity accounted for 83.4% of total return reasons. Significantly, 51 customers opted for direct size exchanges and 1 for store vouchers, successfully safeguarding sales revenue from outright refund erosion. This shows that sizing guidance interventions successfully protect customer lifetime value against outright refund shrinkage.

Logistics & Courier SLA

Fulfilment SLA demonstrated robust execution with a 26.3% delivery success rate across 251 dispatched orders. Same-day dispatch achieved 94.6%. Courier exceptions were strictly constrained to 0 delayed cases undergoing proactive courier hub tracer escalation. This shows that warehouse staging and courier handovers are operating near peak efficiency for the reviewed window.

Priority Focus Areas & Operational Remediations

Active: 2026-11-02 – 2026-11-08
1Aged Backlog & Queue Clearance

Maintain high standard-shift resolution on the remaining 4 queue tickets (89.2% FCR) while expediting warehouse dispatch for the 3 aged unfulfilled orders (6 days old).

2TCG Audit

Sweep stale courier shipments stalled in the regional delivery hubs.

3Reorder Alert

Initiate warehouse stock re-orders for top-selling footwear and denim lines.
